models: Exact GT-03/04 verified SHA-bound existing v6 medium detector/recognizer, copied to new local cache; no downloads or substitutions
input: Same GT-04 640x160 white RGB synthetic Latin chord-like text; no score/reference input
observability: Existing Paddle disable_signal_handler plus Python faulthandler, flushed stage markers, model/predictor option dumps. Same across compared cases. Native core up to 512MiB for initial recognizer only if kernel permits. No debugger/compiler is installed in image; host installed LLDB may inspect retained core. Never install a debugger/model.
controls: Do not combine omp1, cpu1 and newir-off. Dump effective predictor configuration to verify single-field changes. If an option is unsupported, record failure; do not substitute flags.
stop: At most these five model experiments; no Bb OCR or new runtime versions. Native root cause identified only if stack/effective configuration and controlled outcomes sufficiently explain common failure. A workaround alone is not a proven root cause.
evidence: Record exact command, source/model hashes, stage logs, exits, time, limits, peak child RSS where available, and core/debugger outcome. No recognition accuracy claim. No production code change.
